title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
altTitle: Released in the US as Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
setting: Boats crossing the lake to the castle at night
tagline: The first crossing, by lantern light.
summary: An orphaned boy learns on his eleventh birthday that he belongs to a hidden world, and arrives at a school of magic where friendship, a three-headed guard dog and a well-hidden stone wait for him.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
setting: A flying car over the countryside, then into the castle corridors
tagline: Missed the train? Take the scenic route.
summary: A second year opens with a warning, a flying car and a tree that fights back, then turns darker as students are found frozen and a whispering voice moves through the walls.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
setting: Clock tower and courtyard, a misty hillside hut
tagline: Time, frost and a long shadow on the hill.
summary: An escaped prisoner is said to be hunting Harry, the school is ringed by soul-chilling guards, and a third year full of secrets ends with a clever twist in time.

title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
setting: A tournament maze of hedges, the lake, dragon-fire light
tagline: Three tasks. One cup. No way out but through.
summary: A dangerous tournament returns, a fourth name comes out of the goblet, and three tasks (fire, water and a living maze) lead to the night everything changes.

title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
setting: A hall of endless glowing glass shelves
tagline: Rows of light, and one that bears your name.
summary: Disbelieved by the wizarding world and watched by a smiling tyrant of a teacher, Harry forms a secret army of students, and is lured into the deepest halls of the Ministry.

title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
setting: An astronomy tower under a storm sky
tagline: Lessons in the dark, and a storm over the tower.
summary: A borrowed textbook full of handwritten notes, private lessons in a dead man's memories and a summer of teenage romance all lead to the top of the tallest tower.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 1
setting: A lonely tent in a frozen forest
tagline: No school, no shelter, only the road.
summary: With the Ministry fallen, three friends leave everything behind to hunt for hidden fragments of a dark wizard's soul, living rough and growing apart in the cold.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2
setting: Castle grounds at dawn after the battle
tagline: The last night, and the first morning after.
summary: The hunt ends where it began: a break-in, a dragon, and a battle for the castle that ends with dawn breaking over the broken bridge.
